name: AEC-Q100 Rev-H Grade 0 temperature cycling (-55 C to +150 C, 2000 cycles) and power temperature cycling (Ta -40 C to +150 C, 1000 cycles)
plain_name: Qualify a car chip for engine-bay heat and winter cold by cycling it, including while powered
description: Automotive IC qualification for Grade 0 (ambient -40 C to +150 C): test A4 temperature cycling per JESD22-A104 from -55 C to +150 C for 2000 cycles with hot electrical test before and after, and test A5 power temperature cycling per JESD22-A105 at Ta -40 C to +150 C for 1000 cycles with the device powered (no thermal shut-down allowed).
keywords: Qualify a car chip for engine-bay heat and winter cold by cycling it, including while powered

sources.citation: AEC-Q100 Rev-H: Failure Mechanism Based Stress Test Qualification for Integrated Circuits (Automotive Electronics Council, 11 Sep 2014)

requirements.rationale: Grade 0 TC (test A4) cold extreme is -55 C = 218.15 K.
Grade 0 TC hot extreme is +150 C = 423.15 K.
Grade 0 PTC (test A5, JESD22-A105) cycles the ambient from -40 C (233.15 K) to +150 C (423.15 K).
Power temperature cycling runs the parts powered during the cycling (thermal shut-down must not occur), so bias wiring into the chamber is needed.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
